title: Hire Your Anthropologist! Rethinking Culture Benchmarks Through an Anthropological Lens
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates and categorizes benchmarks specifically designed for moral reasoning, ethical dilemmas, and social norms (such as Moral Bench, Moral Stories, and Social Chemistry 101). Additionally, it discusses the inclusion of religious rituals and traditions (e.g., Diwali, Ramadan, Ganesh Chaturthi) as part of cultural factual knowledge evaluation.
